description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the BuzzAnniversaryDao class, which is part of the Buzz plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to retrieving upcoming employee anniversaries, verifying correct filtering and counting logic.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the methods of BuzzAnniversaryDao, focusing on retrieving upcoming employee anniversaries and related counts.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the BuzzAnniversaryDao instance and loads test fixture data into the test database.

methods.name: testGetUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Tests the fetching of upcoming anniversaries list given various filter parameters, asserting expected employee numbers and counts.

methods.name: testGetUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Tests the counting of upcoming anniversaries based on filter parameters, verifying the expected number of upcoming anniversaries.
